evidence_policy: Source tests never promote an inherently physical procedure. Physical outcomes require traceable real bench logs tied to the stated revision, with independent review beyond schema validation.

evidence_classes.source: Can be TESTED with an executed source receipt on exact commit
evidence_classes.mixed: Software may be TESTED but physical acceptance requires a separate physical measurement
evidence_classes.physical: Cannot advance to TESTED based only on source checks; requires MEASURED/QUALIFIED and actual physical evidence
